responsibility: This header defines the `tsv110_tunings` model for the HiSilicon/Phytium TSV110-class core in the AArch64 backend. It provides TSV110-specific address costs, register-move costs, AdvSIMD vector costs, prefetch settings, issue rate, fusion mask, and other `tune_params` fields, giving the backend a dedicated instruction-cost and scheduling profile that complements the separate TSV110 scheduler machine description.
same_name_distinction: This `tsv110` file is the tuning-model header that defines `tsv110_tunings` cost tables and heuristics; the same-stem file `gcc/config/aarch64/tsv110.md` instead contains the scheduler machine description, including the TSV110-specific derived NEON instruction-type classification and instruction reservation model.
